recipes.name: Shoyu Butter Udon Noodles
instructions: Fill a saucepan with boiling water, and add the udon noodles. Cook for 2 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, add the butter and mushrooms to a large pan over high heat. Cook until the mushrooms are lightly golden, about 4 minutes.
Add the drained noodles, green onion, soy sauce, mushroom sauce, and garlic powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Lastly, add the edamame beans and cook until heated through. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage The noodles can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
